title: An idea becomes a connected system — Stop-Motion Animation preview

scenes.title: The idea lands
scenes.purpose: Establish the handmade tabletop set and drop the idea, a yellow clay ball, onto it with weight.
visuals: Flat sage-green painted card backdrop with a soft falloff; kraft corrugated card tabletop
Yellow clay ball lowered over 6 exposures, squash on contact, small rebound, settle
Digital title layer steps in on the exposure cadence; exposure-sheet strip fills one cell per ball key pose
assets: src/scene.js (procedural Three.js clay set, bundled to scene.bundle.js)

beats.development: Title lines step in (3 exposures each) while the clay ball drops from above frame into the set; its contact shadow tightens as it nears the card.
Contact exposure squashes the ball, one rebound exposure, then it settles at rest; the fourth strip cell fills.

scenes.title: The system is built
scenes.purpose: Show the idea connecting outward: rolled clay coils extend across the card and each coil is met by a clay block set down in place.
visuals: Charcoal clay coils roll out over 6 exposures each with a rounded growing tip
Red, blue, cream and charcoal clay blocks lowered with a slight tilt, then a landing squash exposure

beats.development: Coil 1 runs from the ball to the red block (lands 1.17 s); coil 2 runs on to the blue block (lands 1.5 s).
Coil 3 reaches the cream block (lands 1.83 s); coil 4 loops from the ball to the front charcoal block (lands 2.17 s); the last squash resolves by 2.33 s and the slate counter stops.

scenes.title: Hold on the connected system
scenes.purpose: Settled reading hold of the finished network and the headline.
visuals: Static final set: ball, four blocks, four coils, contact shadows, title and strip

beats.development: No movement; full composition legible and settled.

findings: Poses are evaluated at 12 exposures per second (held on twos at 24) inside a 30 fps delivery, so each pose is held for 2–3 encoded frames.
The headline is fully legible by 0.42 s and stays fully legible through 3.0 s.
One primary action at a time: ball drop, then one coil plus block per 0.33 s step, read left to right then front.
All foreground motion ends by 2.33 s, before the 2.7 s settle requirement.
justifiedHolds: 2.4–3.0 s final hold lets the viewer read the completed network and headline together.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects, voice or audio track.
Digital simulation of stop motion (Three.js WebGL, exposure-quantized poses); not photographed frames.
STYLE.json lists no tech.preview_recipes, so no reviewed recipe is demonstrated; the refresh is in the source-frame palette and material lessons.
